messages:
maya: thinking out loud — users keep asking for a cost preview when they save a per-route view. can we show an estimated tokens/cost for the selected model + time range before they save?

sanjay: +1. would need sampling to estimate. full scan is expensive. we should expose a preview API that runs an async sample job or uses cached telemetry histograms.

alex: main UX risk: people will rely on estimates and assume exactness. we need a clear "estimate" badge and confidence band. also quota implications: if a saved view triggers alerts or exports, quota checks should be on save, not just preview.

liz: product note — preview must be fast (<1s ideally). If sampling is async, show a quick heuristic first (historic avg tokens per request * routes) then replace with sample result.

maya: proposal for API shape (sketch):

```
GET /api/console/v1/views/preview?route_id=R123&model=gpt-open-13k&range=30d&sample_pct=1
200 OK
{
  "estimate_tokens": 1_234_567,
  "estimate_cost_usd": 12.34,
  "confidence": "low",
  "sampled_requests": 1234,
  "method": "histogram+sample"
}
```

sanjay: looks good. we should return telemetry keys to attach to events: e.g., telemetry_event: "console.view.preview" and include sample_id so we can link the sample work to logs.

alex: engineering question — where does this run? host runtime or analytics infra? if we hit clickhouse for histograms that's fine, but any sampling that pulls request bodies for tokenization needs access to parsed telemetry or precomputed token counts. we must avoid tokenizing at query time.

liz: we already store token_count in telemetry for most routes (console-request.token_count). if missing we should fallback to model-estimated tokens via prompt length; not ideal but ok for heuristic.

maya: UX edgecases: saved views can be scoped to multiple models or route groups. API should accept multiple models and return per-model breakdown + aggregate. Also show quota impact per team.

alex: sketch for multi-model response: 
```
{
  "per_model": {"gpt-open-13k": {"tokens": 800k, "cost": 8.0}, "dolly-7b": {"tokens": 450k, "cost": 4.3}},
  "aggregate": {"tokens": 1_250_000, "cost": 12.3}
}
```

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled infra rollout v23.4 at 03:00 UTC — analytics DB maintenance window. sampling jobs may be delayed ~30m after deploy. :warning:

sanjay: good call. make preview API tolerant of stale histograms — return timestamp for last_histogram_update and mark stale if >6h.

maya: action items: (1) eng: add preview endpoint that reads token_count histograms + optional sampling job (sanjay + alex) (2) product: design compact cost badge + confidence tooltip (maya + liz) (3) telemetry: add sample_id and preview_event to schema (sanjay) — aim for prototype next week.

alex: one more internal API debate — should the preview be part of the views service or the telemetry service? I vote telemetry service (single source of truth for histograms) but expose through console proxy for auth.

maya: agreed, telemetry service with console proxy. keep contract minimal. i'll draft API doc and share here tomorrow. :thumbsup:

liz: UI will mock with placeholder numbers until backend ready. i'll do a dark-mode and compact layout test.

maya: thanks all — leaving notes in the epic.
